title: Stabilizer Structure in One Positive Depth Block
body_html:
Stabilizer Structure in One Positive Depth Block

For a single positive-depth block and \(w\) realizing the target lift, let \[ S=\operatorname{Stab}_{K\times K'}(w+B_0). \] The stabilizer is generated by diagonal subgroups \(\Delta^i\) coming from the transported centralizers, together with the depth \(s\) Moy-Prasad subgroups on both sides. Its pro-unipotent part has the analogous product decomposition with \(+\)-depth subgroups.
proof_html: The proof compares \(g'\,w\,g^{-1}\) with \(w\). The map \(d\alpha\) sends source Moy-Prasad layers to target layers, while the complementary term \(d\alpha^\perp\) is deeper and hence lies in \(B_{0+}\). This shows \(\Delta^i\subset S\). Conversely, projecting any stabilizer element to the source side and correcting by the matching \(\Delta^i\)'s leaves an element stabilizing \(w\) from only one side, hence in the depth \(s\) subgroup.
